case "$PWD" in *.claude/worktrees/*) BR=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$BR" in *BOOKSHELF-[0-9]*|main|master|HEAD) : ;; *) echo "[branch-guard] Worktree branch '$BR' has no Jira key.
